Never put a rejected or withdrawn artifact in evidence. Approve only a draft you are confident is current and correct. lookup_available=true means you may reply {"decision":"lookup"} (other fields null or empty) to retrieve, once, the recorded lineage behind each queued draft: artifact versions, delivered-input dependency links and invalidation status, with no additional bodies; a second request will then deliver those records.
